bootstrap.unit: 141 frozen connected components, paired across endpoints

interpretation: Compare each fixed H272 half-blend directly with the ordinary GCorr head half-blend as well as with the parent. The readout and control fit different training memberships, so these endpoint contrasts do not isolate a pure method effect. Fold 0 is exposed; bootstrap uncertainty is conditional on fixed predictions and does not estimate training variation or public transfer. Observed fixed endpoint deltas: ordinary GCorr control vs parent +0.0008319501; H272 hidden-only vs GCorr control -0.0004602302; H272 multiplicative/contextual vs GCorr control -0.0007893410.
